restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text:
I had a great experience at Patipat clinic.  I went on two separate occasions and each time it was great.
I chose the teeth cleaning treatment. The pricing is fair and the staff is very welcoming and friendly.
The clinic is hygienic and offers a number of services.
I would highly recommend to friends and family!

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text:
The tartar removal was very detailed. Silicones were used to help open the mouth more comfortably. They used a digging tool and hand-dug the hard-to-reach spaces between the teeth. Finally, a veneer was applied. The dentist also performed a further checkup on the teeth, as they appeared to have cavities, so an X-ray was performed.

The system was quite convenient. Patients could see the details of the X-ray images on the dental chair screen. Overall, the dentist was kind and the assistants were accommodating. The price was reasonable, considering the inflation rate. 😅😬

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text:
The staff and the dentist were very polite. The service was excellent. I called to schedule an appointment beforehand, and when I arrived, I was able to get my teeth done right away. Others who hadn't made an appointment had to wait. I just went straight into the treatment room, and the people waiting before me just stared at me in amazement.

The entire process, from checking in at the counter to seeing the dentist and finishing the procedure, took only 15 minutes. It was incredibly fast. I paid 1000 baht and that was it.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text: The doctor and caregiver were kind and helpful. They explained the treatment plan before starting and described the condition of my teeth. You can inquire about the price before the procedure.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text: Everyone provided excellent service; they were polite and friendly. The only issue was the price didn't match the sign outside. I went for a teeth cleaning, and the sign said 800 baht, but when I went in, they charged 1880 baht. I was very disappointed and felt let down, as I had hoped to find a clinic I liked.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text: The doctor was very gentle and spoke very well from the moment I arrived at the counter. They even called to check on my condition after the extraction, which was great. I highly recommend them. The price is also very reasonable. 🥰🥰 …
author_name: สุนิษา จันทร์พฤกษ์

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text: I've used their services 3 times and had a flawless experience. The doctor and staff are polite, always explaining everything beforehand and clarifying any dental issues. Appointments are punctual, the prices are reasonable, and they explain the payment details clearly every time. There's also motorcycle parking available.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text:
Excellent service, gentle dentist, and very thorough explanations.
I highly recommend this place to anyone who is afraid of dental work. The dentist is very kind.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text: I booked an appointment for 4:00 PM. The doctor arrived at 4:30 PM. She couldn't see the granuloma and immediately suggested tooth extraction. However, conservative treatment (root canal cleaning) or root canal surgery are available.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปฏิพัทธ์ Patipat Dental
text: The doctor and all the staff are very kind. I really like this clinic. Everyone gave great advice.
